Set a parameter on a parameter object

Source: R/params-setters.R
ccparams_setters.Rd

Change one parameter of a BFVParams, BGVParams, or CKKSParams object after it has been constructed. Each function wraps the CCParams<T>::Set* method of the same name. The parameter constructors take the same parameters as arguments; these functions are for code that builds a parameter object step by step, as the OpenFHE examples do.

Usage

set_plaintext_modulus(params, ...)

set_digit_size(params, ...)

set_standard_deviation(params, ...)

set_secret_key_dist(params, ...)

set_max_relin_sk_deg(params, ...)

set_pre_mode(params, ...)

set_multiparty_mode(params, ...)

set_execution_mode(params, ...)

set_decryption_noise_mode(params, ...)

set_noise_estimate(params, ...)

set_desired_precision(params, ...)

set_statistical_security(params, ...)

set_num_adversarial_queries(params, ...)

set_threshold_num_of_parties(params, ...)

set_key_switch_technique(params, ...)

set_scaling_technique(params, ...)

set_batch_size(params, ...)

set_first_mod_size(params, ...)

set_num_large_digits(params, ...)

set_multiplicative_depth(params, ...)

set_scaling_mod_size(params, ...)

set_security_level(params, ...)

set_ring_dim(params, ...)

set_eval_add_count(params, ...)

set_key_switch_count(params, ...)

set_encryption_technique(params, ...)

set_multiplication_technique(params, ...)

set_pre_num_hops(params, ...)

set_interactive_boot_compression_level(params, ...)

set_composite_degree(params, ...)

set_register_word_size(params, ...)

Arguments

params

A BFVParams, BGVParams, or CKKSParams object.

...

Method-specific arguments: value, the new value of the parameter.

Value

params, invisibly. The object is modified in place.

Details

Every setter is defined for all three parameter classes, as in the C++ library. A parameter that a scheme does not use is refused by OpenFHE, and its error is raised: for example set_plaintext_modulus() on a CKKSParams object.

Parameters whose values are members of an enumeration take the member, for example set_security_level(p, SecurityLevel$HEStd_128_classic).

Functions

  • set_plaintext_modulus: plaintext modulus (BFV, BGV). A whole number of at most 2^53, or a string of decimal digits.

  • set_digit_size: digit size for BV key switching.

  • set_standard_deviation: standard deviation of the error distribution.

  • set_secret_key_dist: secret-key distribution, a member of SecretKeyDist.

  • set_max_relin_sk_deg: maximum degree of the secret key for which relinearization keys are generated.

  • set_pre_mode: proxy re-encryption mode, a member of PREMode.

  • set_multiparty_mode: multiparty mode, a member of MultipartyMode.

  • set_execution_mode: execution mode (CKKS), a member of ExecutionMode.

  • set_decryption_noise_mode: decryption noise mode (CKKS), a member of DecryptionNoiseMode.

  • set_noise_estimate: noise estimate for noise flooding (CKKS).

  • set_desired_precision: desired precision for noise flooding (CKKS).

  • set_statistical_security: statistical security, in bits, for noise flooding.

  • set_num_adversarial_queries: bound on the number of adversarial queries, for noise flooding.

  • set_threshold_num_of_parties: number of parties in threshold FHE.

  • set_key_switch_technique: key-switching technique, a member of KeySwitchTechnique.

  • set_scaling_technique: scaling technique, a member of ScalingTechnique.

  • set_batch_size: batch size (number of plaintext slots).

  • set_first_mod_size: bit size of the first modulus.

  • set_num_large_digits: number of large digits for hybrid key switching.

  • set_multiplicative_depth: multiplicative depth.

  • set_scaling_mod_size: bit size of the scaling moduli.

  • set_security_level: security level, a member of SecurityLevel.

  • set_ring_dim: ring dimension.

  • set_eval_add_count: number of additions per level (BFV, BGV).

  • set_key_switch_count: number of key switches per level (BFV, BGV).

  • set_encryption_technique: encryption technique (BFV), a member of EncryptionTechnique.

  • set_multiplication_technique: multiplication technique (BFV), a member of MultiplicationTechnique.

  • set_pre_num_hops: number of proxy re-encryption hops (BGV).

  • set_interactive_boot_compression_level: compression level for interactive bootstrapping (CKKS), a member of CompressionLevel.

  • set_composite_degree: composite degree for composite scaling (CKKS).

  • set_register_word_size: register word size for composite scaling (CKKS).

See also

ccparams_getters for the matching get_* functions; BFVParams(), BGVParams(), CKKSParams().

Examples

p <- CKKSParams()
set_multiplicative_depth(p, 2L)
set_scaling_mod_size(p, 50L)
set_batch_size(p, 8L)
get_multiplicative_depth(p)
#> [1] 2
